faqs.a: Trash and recycling go out Monday nights for Tuesday pickup in Ward 4. Yard waste is every other Wednesday.
Couches, mattresses and appliances: book a free bulk pickup through the city (up to 4 a year). Leaving them on the curb without booking can get a fine.
Street sweeping is Tuesday 8 to 11 AM on Elm and Oak. Move your car or get a $45 ticket.
City Hall is open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Permits, parking passes and water bills are handled at the first-floor service desk.
Block-party and yard-sale permits are free and take about 3 business days. Construction permits go through the Building Department at City Hall.
Riverside Library is open 9 AM to 8 PM weekdays and 10 AM to 5 PM weekends. Free Wi-Fi, printing at 10 cents a page.
The Ward 4 community meeting is Thursday at 6:30 PM at Riverside Library. This week's topic is the Main St bike lane.
Downtown street parking is free after 6 PM and on Sundays. Residential permit zones need a sticker from City Hall.

places.name: Green Fork Kitchen
places.allergens: Uses cashews and sesame in several sauces. Ask for the allergen sheet.

places.name: Tony's Pizza
places.allergens: Gluten-free crust is baked in the same oven, so there is cross-contact risk for celiac.

places.name: Sakura Sushi
places.allergens: Shellfish and sesame are used throughout. Tamari available instead of soy sauce.

places.name: Al-Noor Grill
places.allergens: Tahini (sesame) in most dishes. Nut-free kitchen.

places.name: Sunrise Bakery
places.allergens: Certified nut-free facility. Contains wheat, eggs and dairy.

places.name: Bean There Cafe
places.allergens: Almond milk and nut pastries on site. Gluten-free muffins are pre-packaged.

places.name: Taqueria La Esquina
places.allergens: Corn tortillas are gluten-free. Beans are cooked with lard, so not vegetarian unless you ask for black beans.

places.name: Riverside Fresh Market
places.allergens: Dedicated allergy-friendly aisle and labeled bulk bins.

places.name: Riverside Library
places.cuisine: Library, free Wi-Fi, printing, meeting rooms
